audit_type: Independent GLB binary/JSON audit using Python standard library

files.scope: A+B+Bridge+Court, excluding C placeholder and context
One office corner trial mesh, excluding context

units_and_axes.gltf: glTF 2.0 positions are metres, right-handed +Y up; transformed world bounds are reported
units_and_axes.ue_bounds_conversion: (glTF x, glTF z, glTF y), metres; multiply by 100 for UE centimetres

limitations: No Blender, UE, render, model edit, or export operation is performed.
glTF defines metre units, but the file alone cannot prove that the authored building has its intended real-world dimensions.
Exclusion checks use camera/light fields, mesh counts and identifiable C/placeholder/context names; disguised or renamed context geometry cannot be identified automatically.
Finite UV0/UV1 data does not prove UV island separation, acceptable texel density, or lightmap readiness. UV overlaps are not tested.
Self-intersections, duplicate surfaces, watertightness, bridge portal continuity and structural/accessibility design are not tested.
Stored unit normals do not establish intended split-normal shading, smooth curve reflections, or material fidelity.
Technical PASS is not visual approval or a claim of final city quality. Camera visibility, UE materials/collision and runtime cost remain unverified.
